title: Reactor theorized as a cyclotron hitting element 115

tellings.quote: So, it was theorized apparently Barry with his other lab partner, they thought that was a cyclotron, an accelerator.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site called S4 in the Nevada desert in the late 1980s, talks about the reactor that he says powered those craft. Lazar says a colleague named Barry Castilio and another lab partner thought part of it was a cyclotron, a kind of particle accelerator, firing at element 115, a very heavy chemical element. If true, it would offer a physical explanation for how the craft got their power.
